'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Greg Shaw LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
